title: Unit 5 Consolidation: El Salvador and Honduras
goal: Review Copán, northern Honduras, Romero and the war, migration, and recent events, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: cuyo, dijo que and según, sin embargo and no obstante, debido a and a raíz de, the passive with ser

items: I can review what I learned about El Salvador and Honduras, from Copán to recent events.
I can use *cuyo*, *dijo que* and *según*, *sin embargo* and *no obstante*, *debido a* and *a raíz de*, and the passive with *ser*.
I can put events from Copán to the 2025 election in order.
I can cite a source when I talk about recent events.
I can say whose monuments or coasts I mean, with *cuyo*.
I can report what people said and name my source, with *dijo que* and *según*.
I can show a contrast with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.
I can give a cause with *debido a* and *a raíz de*, and a dated fact with the passive with *ser*.
